steps.name: design
prompt: Read the relevant code first, then write a design; change no code. Put it in {{run}}/design.md, as short as the task allows: what the implementer needs to know (the files and functions to change, changes to interfaces or data, edge cases, how to test it), no code listings.

steps.name: implement
steps.label: implementation
prompt: The design is in {{run}}/design.md: read it, implement it, and run the relevant tests. Change nothing in {{run}}/.
When done, commit the change as one commit.
again: Fix them one by one; where you disagree, say why. Run the relevant tests, and commit as one commit.

steps.name: review
prompt: Review the change, git diff {{base}} (uncommitted work included), against {{run}}/design.md. Read only: change no files.
Report only real problems: bugs, missed requirements, clear risks. At most 5, one line each, naming the file and why.
again: The implementer has worked through your last review. Review git diff {{base}} again: are those problems solved, and are there new ones? At most 5.
